instructions: Read docs/verification/release-v1.0.3-20261017.md and tool-images.json. Use the final release tag for the checked-in tools. Program inputs remain identical to source_base; build-inputs.json lists every hash.

Use a fresh output directory owned by UID/GID 1000:1000. Keep original inputs read-only. Mount the project at /src:ro and the new output at /out:rw. All Docker calls use --rm --network none, bounded outer timeout, memory, CPU and pids limits.
The original staged release tools were copied during prepare. Their hashes are stored separately as staged_release_tool_snapshots in build-inputs.json; final tool snapshots are in recipe/.

Controlled capture helpers are in recipe/workspace/. Pass build-hd-scenes.sh to bash inside the package image; it reads the retained fixtures referenced by the formal HD receipts. Run native and Wine capture using the generated main-thread driver, then check-hd-scenes.py. These helpers do not ship in packages.
The normal sample is predeclared with seed 1 and runs once. Do not replace failed samples with a different seed. Full trace and v3 equality are checked by the existing sampler.
After both actual package controls finish, run pixels, compose the movie, inspect all twelve decoded frames, create the four-attachment authorization manifest, then run closeout_release.py verify.

The authoritative raw evidence, failures, capture audio, full frame sets and all exact commands recorded by runtime scripts remain local under dist-all/v.1.0.3-20261017/smoke/. Compact receipts and preview provenance are checked in.
This records a reproducible workflow and pinned inputs. ZIP timestamps and container run times are not a claim of byte-identical archives.

phases.requires: bounded Xvfb owner and ready display

publication.upload: three release engine packages and release/SHA256SUMS.txt only
